name: hubspot-oauth-app
description: HubSpot public app with OAuth flow, Neon Postgres token storage, and CRM Contacts fetch

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev -w apps/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev -w apps/frontend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.start:backend: node init && npm run start -w apps/backend
